Update the labels on a resource.

  *  A label key and value must begin with a letter or number, and may contain letters, numbers, hyphens, dots, and underscores, up to 63 characters each.
  *  Optionally, the key can begin with a DNS subdomain prefix and a single '/', like example.com/my-app.
  *  If --overwrite is true, then existing labels can be overwritten, otherwise attempting to overwrite a label will result in an error.
  *  KEY- removes the label KEY; removing a label that is not set changes nothing. A change that leaves the labels as they were prints not labeled.

Resource types: projects (project, proj) and groups (group). Type words are case-insensitive.

Examples:
  # Update project 'hldr' with the label 'lang' and the value 'rust'
  slipway label project hldr lang=rust

  # Update project 'hldr' with the label 'lang' and the value 'go', overwriting any existing value
  slipway label project hldr lang=go --overwrite

  # Remove the label 'tier' from project 'hldr'
  slipway label project hldr tier-

  # List the labels of group 'work'
  slipway label group work --list

Options:
      --overwrite          If true, allow labels to be overwritten, otherwise reject label updates that overwrite existing labels.
      --list               If true, display the labels for a given resource instead of writing them.
      --dry-run STRATEGY   Only print what would change, without writing anything, when the strategy is client. One of: none, client. (default "none")

Usage:
  slipway label (TYPE NAME | TYPE/NAME) [KEY=VALUE|KEY-...] [flags]

Use "slipway --help" for a list of global options (applies to all commands).
